name: Singapore University of Social Sciences
summary: Singapore university for applied social sciences with eleven full-time degrees open to international students on a Student’s Pass; one July intake.

handoff.label: Full-time degrees open to international students

ib.text: Open to IB Diploma holders; you authorise the IB to release your transcript to SUSS. No IB points or subjects are listed; ask the admissions office what grades are competitive.

dates.label: Applications open for the July 2027 intake
Applications close for the July 2027 intake

programmes.name: Accountancy
programmes.about: Trains you as an accountant through accounting, assurance and attestation, law, taxation and information technology, with general business knowledge alongside.
programmes.selectionNote: Shortlisted applicants sit a response essay, an online cognitive test and a programme interview; abroad, it may be online. No IB grade profile is published.

programmes.name: Early Childhood Education
programmes.about: A multi-disciplinary degree for working with young children; open to applicants with or without an ECE diploma. IB Diploma holders take the four-year track.
programmes.selectionNote: Essay, cognitive test and interview if shortlisted; rank it first or second choice to be considered. No IB grade profile is published.

programmes.name: Human Resource Management
programmes.about: Prepares you as a specialist HR practitioner, treating human resources as part of corporate and business strategy rather than a support function.
programmes.selectionNote: Shortlisted applicants sit a response essay, an online cognitive test and a programme interview; abroad, it may be online. No IB grade profile is published.

programmes.name: Public Safety and Security
programmes.credential: Bachelor of Public Safety and Security
programmes.about: A four-year degree that professionalises public safety and security, from terrorism to cybercrime, with courses such as the psychological perspective to public safety.
programmes.selectionNote: Shortlisted applicants sit a response essay, an online cognitive test and a programme interview; abroad, it may be online. No IB grade profile is published.

programmes.name: Business Analytics
programmes.credential: Bachelor of Science in Business Analytics
programmes.about: A four-year direct honours degree of 200 credit units that adds statistics and analytics to the SUSS Core, with a 24-week work attachment.
programmes.selectionNote: Shortlisted applicants sit a response essay, an online cognitive test and a programme interview; abroad, it may be online. No IB grade profile is published.

programmes.name: Finance
programmes.about: A four-year direct honours degree of 200 credit units in finance, with a 24-week work attachment, an overseas experience and a community engagement.
programmes.selectionNote: Shortlisted applicants sit a response essay, an online cognitive test and a programme interview; abroad, it may be online. No IB grade profile is published.

programmes.name: Information and Communication Technology
programmes.about: A four-year full-time degree covering computer science foundations, software and application development and networking, with maths electives such as statistics and cryptography.
programmes.selectionNote: Shortlisted applicants sit a response essay, an online cognitive test and a programme interview; abroad, it may be online. No IB grade profile is published.

programmes.name: Marketing
programmes.about: An applied marketing degree drawing on psychology, economics and statistics to decide what to sell, at what price and to whom, on a broad business base.
programmes.selectionNote: Shortlisted applicants sit a response essay, an online cognitive test and a programme interview; abroad, it may be online. No IB grade profile is published.

programmes.name: Psychology
programmes.about: A broad degree in theoretical, conceptual and analytical skills in psychology, with electives such as work psychology and health psychology and well-being.
programmes.selectionNote: Essay, cognitive test and interview if shortlisted; rank it first or second choice to be considered. No IB grade profile is published.
programmes.ib: Minimums are set in local grades (O Level English B4, Maths C5); ask SUSS for the IB equivalent. Rank Psychology first or second choice.

programmes.name: Supply Chain Management
programmes.about: Built with the Singapore Logistics Association to prepare supply chain talent for Singapore and Southeast Asia, with critical thinking and decision-making skills.
programmes.selectionNote: Shortlisted applicants sit a response essay, an online cognitive test and a programme interview; abroad, it may be online. No IB grade profile is published.

programmes.name: Social Work
programmes.about: A degree giving the knowledge, skills and values for a social work career in Singapore, with an emphasis on equity and inclusion.
programmes.selectionNote: Essay, cognitive test and interview if shortlisted; rank it first or second choice to be considered. No IB grade profile is published.

notes: EU students can take the MOE Tuition Grant, which cuts the fee but requires you to work for a Singapore entity for three years after graduating.
You apply on up to four ranked choices; Early Childhood Education, Psychology and Social Work are only considered if ranked first or second.
Offers are conditional on a Student’s Pass, which needs a medical examination including tests for tuberculosis and HIV.
